window.title: Strategy Board Import
ui.header: Paste Strategy Board share codes here. The plugin writes them into the Saved List (the vanilla field truncates long folder codes). You can also wipe every saved board at once — the game has no bulk delete.
ui.single_import_help: Import writes the board into the Saved List. If Strategy Board is open, it reloads on its own. Import raw input still fills the in-game share-code field.
ui.folder_import_help: Import writes every page into the Saved List and puts them in the named folder. Saved List: up to {0} boards in total. A folder holds at most {1} boards; extra pages go into additional folders named like "Name (2)".
ui.import_all_n: Import all {0} boards into a folder
ui.import_all: Import all boards into a folder
ui.delete_all_saved_confirm: Click again to delete {0} boards and {1} folders
ui.delete_all_saved_help: Clears the Saved List (boards and folders). Shared List is not touched. This cannot be undone.
ui.language_help: Language of this plugin window. Auto follows the game client.
ui.show_chat_messages_help: Print [SBI] lines in the game chat. Status still appears in this window either way.
status.paste_hint: Paste a share code and check it.
status.found_with_decode_errors: {0} share code(s) found. {1} name(s) could not be decoded.
status.copied_all: {0} codes copied to the clipboard. Import them one by one in the share-code window.
command.help: Opens the Strategy Board importer for long share codes.
command.no_code: No share code in the command arguments.
import.no_field: No share-code input field found. In game open Strategy Board → New Strategy → Share Code, then try again.
import.wrote_confirmed: Wrote code ({0} characters) into '{1}' and confirmed it.
import.wrote_manual: Wrote code ({0} characters) into '{1}'. Click Apply/OK in the game window.
import.native_folder_split_ok: Imported {0} boards into {1} folders (max {2} per folder), starting with "{3}".
import.native_folder_partial_ok: Imported {0} boards. {1} went into folder "{3}" (max {2} per folder); the rest stayed in the Saved List root.
import.native_full: The Saved List is full (max {0} boards).
import.native_unavailable: Strategy Board data is not ready. Open Strategy Board once, then try again.
import.native_failed: Could not write the board into the Saved List.
import.native_folder_failed: Could not create or find folder "{0}".
delete.all_empty: The Saved List is already empty.
delete.all_ok: Deleted {0} boards and {1} folders from the Saved List.
delete.all_partial: Could not clear the Saved List completely ({0} boards and {1} folders remain).
folder.saved_list_cap: The Saved List holds at most {0} boards in total. Importing the first {0}.
folder.start: Create or open folder "{0}" (name is on the clipboard). Then New Strategy → Share Code. Page {1}/{2} will be filled automatically.
folder.imported: Imported {0}/{1}: {2}. If the window stays open, click OK in game. Then open New Strategy → Share Code again.
folder.done: Done: {0} boards imported. If they are not in folder "{1}", drag them there in Strategy Board.
folder.waiting: Waiting for the share-code window for page {0}/{1}.
folder.waiting_hint: Open New Strategy → Share Code (not a blank board). The plugin fills the next page when that window is open.
codec.not_base64: Share code is not valid Base64.
codec.not_enough_data: Share code does not contain enough data.

codec.unpack: Share code could not be unpacked.
codec.not_stgy: Not a Strategy Board share code ([stgy:...]).
